Sitharaman Urges Multilateral Banks for Private Infrastructure Investment

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has urged multilateral banks to facilitate private investment in infrastructure. Speaking at a BRICS forum, she highlighted common structural constraints faced by BRICS economies in mobilizing private capital at scale. Sitharaman called for these banks to lay the groundwork for increased private sector participation in infrastructure development.
